competences.description: Gains Knowledge by the number of granted beneficial effects when you're granted with a beneficial effect. competences.description: Absorbs 25% (10% instead if it's a Boss) of your Attack Power and Defense per Knowledge from the enemy target's Attack Power and Defense. In addition, if you have 5 Knowledge, steals all beneficial effects granted on the enemy and instantly gains another turn. This skill can be used when you have at least 1 Knowledge, and all Knowledge will be consumed once you use the skill. (Accumulates up to 10 times)
